M.M3_hierarchy_path: Product Manager > Community > Identity > Verified Badge

IO1_direct_inputs.name: verification_results
IO1_direct_inputs.schema_ref: { selfie_liveness: bool, face_match: 0.0-1.0, address_match: bool, background_check: 'clear'|'flag'|'unknown' }

IO2_direct_outputs.name: badge_display
IO2_direct_outputs.schema_ref: { icon, color, tooltip: 'fully verified'|'partial verification'|'not verified' }

IO3_transformations.algorithm: selfie_liveness AND face_match>0.95 AND address_match AND background_check='clear' → verified. Partial if 2-3 passed. Otherwise unverified.
Verified: 1 year. Partial: 6 months (require re-verification). Address change triggers re-verification.

DW1_upstream_pipeline.description: All identity verification steps completed (or failed)

DW2_downstream_pipeline.description: Verification level computed from all results
Badge displayed on profile, group directory, etc
Badge influences trust score (used by group suggestions, help matching)
Background job checks for expired badges. Trigger re-verification.

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Badge computation is trivial (logic only). Expiry checking is background job. Badge display cached (no runtime cost).
P.P2_defensibility: Clear logic (pass all = verified, pass some = partial, fail all = unverified). Expiry prevents stale badges. Address change triggers re-verification.
P.P3_confidence_level: Very high confidence. Simple deterministic logic.
P4_failure_modes: Badge computation wrong → user sees wrong badge (mitigate: test logic with all combination inputs)
Badge expiry not enforced → verified badge persists beyond expiry (mitigate: background job checks daily)
Address change not detected → badge not re-verified (mitigate: trigger re-verification on profile update)
P.P5_backup_plan: If badge computation fails: default to unverified (fail-closed). If expiry check fails: manual admin review.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Test all input combinations (16 combinations of 4 boolean inputs). Test expiry logic (set to past, verify rejected). Test address change trigger.
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit tests for badge computation (all input combinations). Integration tests for expiry checking. End-to-end tests for full verification workflow. Badge display accuracy tests.
P.P8_benchmarks: Badge computation: <100ms. Expiry check: background job, completes within 1 hour. Badge display: real-time (no latency). Accuracy: 100% (simple logic).

CH1_change_log.description: Initial CONFolder for verified badge module

L.L1_legal_considerations: Badge accurately represents verification status (no false claims). Users rely on badge for trust decisions. Misinformation could enable fraud. Clear definitions required (what 'verified' means).
L.L3_consent_requirements: User implicitly consents to badge display by completing verification.
L.L4_liability_notes: False positive (unverified user shows verified badge): fraud risk. Mitigation: strict logic, regular audits. False negative (verified user shows unverified badge): harm to user. Mitigation: clear badge definitions, appeals process.

F.F1_cost_considerations: Badge computation and storage: negligible cost.
F.F3_revenue_impact: Verified badge increases user trust and retention (positive impact).

S.S1_cybersecurity: Badge is public (displayed on profile). No security risk. Badge tampering prevented by database constraints.
S.S2_data_privacy: Badge reveals verification status (semi-public). No PII in badge.
S.S4_access_control: Badge visible to all users. Computation only by verification modules.
S.S5_audit_requirements: Log badge creation, expiry, re-verification. Audit trail retention: 1 year.

X.X1_notes: Verified badge is trust signal that users rely on. Clear definitions essential (fully verified = all checks passed, partial = some checks passed). Expiry policy important (keeps data current without constant re-verification). Badge influences trust scoring used by groups and help matching.
X2_open_questions: Partial verification: show badge or not? (partial may confuse users, safer to hide)
Grace period before expiry? (30 days notice before badge expires)
Can admins override badge? (probably not - integrity is critical)
X.X3_related_research: Trust signals in online communities. Badge design and user perception. Fraud in identity-verified systems.
